label: +0.5 cm Structured (Both Sides)
description: A 5mm structured pad uses a firm, non-compressible pad material set with a pronounced roped sleevehead — the wadding is built up at the very edge of the shoulder to create a crisp, square projection that is the unmistakable signature of traditional British military tailoring. The roping raises the sleevehead above the shoulder line by a few millimetres, creating a visible ridge that draws the eye upward and outward, projecting power and formality. This construction is at home in a Savile Row business suit or morning coat and reads instantly as English, authoritative, and deliberately architectural.
